name: ISR Bot daily watch
description: Every morning, check for skill changes, decoy reads and new risks; report what changed and anything that still needs attention, such as open unverified findings or checks that didn't complete.

name: ISR Bot weekly audit
description: Every Sunday, run the full audit, threat brief and weekly report into this chat.

name: ISR Bot weekly tidy
description: Every Sunday, preview the safe cleanup (changes nothing) and ask before applying anything.

name: ISR Bot monthly roll-call
description: On the 1st, post a reminder that a roll-call is due; it runs only after the owner says yes.
